title: Devouring Thunder
summary: On Sheng Tan Planet, Zhang Zhen mocks Wang Lin as a fake envoy and attacks with his family's soul-burning flame, which cannot harm Wang Lin's Illusory Yin puppet; when Wang Lin's thunder arts and the mountain stone push him hard, he hands over a Thunder Cauldron. Zhang Zhen then trades his family's Third Eye divine art for the Celestial Slaughter Art, and each side quietly slips flaws into the copy they give. When the realm opens, immortal thunder comes down to fetch the cauldron's holder; Wang Lin and the Ancient Thunder Dragon swallow as much of it as they can, while the Zhang family on Qing Ling Star worship the light as an immortal. At the gate of the Thunder Celestial Realm, Tang Yanfeng of the Tang family mocks Shengong Hu for losing his standing, just before Wang Lin forces his way through the closed gate. Inside, on the Fragment Continent, Wang Lin heals, while Nirvana Shatterer Yan Leizi on the Black Mountain notices him and plots a grand formation to crush the Alliance and Master Zhong Xuan. Shengong Hu tells Wang Lin about the realm's immortal corpses and origin energy, and when Wang Lin finds a piece of rare origin energy, Xu Fenghan of the Xu family demands he hand it over.
